title: Ntxawm Lub Xauv
blurb: A lock, a lost thread, and a goat in the field.

paragraphs.hmong: Ntxawm muaj lub xauv xim liab uas nws txiv muab rau nws.
paragraphs.english: Ntxawm has a red lock that her father gave her.

paragraphs.hmong: Nws siv lub xauv xauv nws lub thawv me txhua hmo.
paragraphs.english: She uses the lock to lock her little box every night.

paragraphs.hmong: Muaj ib tag kis, Ntxawm pom nws pog koob Zaub nyob tom qab vaj.
paragraphs.english: One morning, Ntxawm saw her great-grandmother Zaub behind the garden.

paragraphs.hmong: Pog Zaub tab tom nrhiav nws lub xov uas poob rau hauv cov nroj tsuag.
paragraphs.english: Grandmother Zaub was looking for her thread, which had fallen into the plants.

paragraphs.hmong: Ntxawm hais tias, “Kuv peev xwm pab koj nrhiav tau.”
paragraphs.english: Ntxawm said, "I can help you find it."

paragraphs.hmong: Nws thiab Pog Zaub nkawd saib hauv qab pob zeb thiab ntawm ib tsob ntoo paj.
paragraphs.english: She and Grandmother Zaub looked under a rock and by a flowering tree.

paragraphs.hmong: Thaum kawg, lawv pom lub xov nyob ze ib lub paj kws.
paragraphs.english: At last, they saw the thread near a corn plant.

paragraphs.hmong: Lub xov ntawd xim daj thiab tseem zoo.
paragraphs.english: That thread was yellow and still good.

paragraphs.hmong: Tom qab ntawd, Ntxawm mus tom teb nrog nws tus kwv Nkaub.
paragraphs.english: After that, Ntxawm went to the field with her younger brother Nkaub.

paragraphs.hmong: Nkawd hnov ib lub suab tuaj ntawm ib sab toj.
paragraphs.english: The two of them heard a sound coming from one side of the hill.

paragraphs.hmong: Nkaub coj nws xib xub, tiam sis nkawd tsis tua dab tsi.
paragraphs.english: Nkaub brought his arrow, but they did not shoot anything.

paragraphs.hmong: Nkawd tsuas pom ib tug kas noj nyom xwb.
paragraphs.english: They only saw a goat eating grass.

paragraphs.hmong: Ntxawm xav pom tus kas kom ze dua, tab sis nws tsis xav ua kom tus kas ntshai.
paragraphs.english: Ntxawm wanted to see the goat closer, but she did not want to frighten it.

paragraphs.hmong: Nws txawm mus tsev thiab qhia nws txiv tias nws tau pab Pog Zaub nrhiav lub xov.
paragraphs.english: So she went home and told her father that she had helped Grandmother Zaub find the thread.

paragraphs.hmong: Nws txiv luag thiab hais tias, “Koj ua tau zoo heev. Koj muaj peev xwm pab lwm tus.”
paragraphs.english: Her father laughed and said, "You did very well. You have the ability to help others."
